verdicts.factCheck: I fetched https://elysium.kinetiq.xyz/docs/trading-on-hypercore-from-elysium (last updated November 2, 2026). It says the keeper lane and the ElysiumCoreWriter predeploy ship in an ArbOS network upgrade about four weeks after mainnet, that a dapp contract binds its HyperCore account on the predeploy, and that a dapp can prefund a HYPE gas escrow there so each action's outcome is delivered back to the originating contract. I fetched https://elysium.kinetiq.xyz/docs/what-is-elysium (last updated November 25, 2026). Its architecture diagram lists the HyperCore data precompile and the ElysiumCoreWriter predeploy as post-launch upgrades. Neither page gives an address or an ABI. On https://rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz at block 0xac230f (nitro/vlocal+unknown-unknown/linux-amd64/go1.25.12) I ran getScheduledUpgrade() on 0x...6b and got 64 zero bytes, and arbOSVersion() on 0x...64 and got 0x74 (116). eth_getCode returns empty code at 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 and at 0x...0800 to 0x...0811, the addresses HyperEVM uses for its CoreWriter and read precompiles, and a balanceOf(PoolManager) eth_call from the PoolManager address to each returns empty data. So no such contract is live today. I did not confirm the count of 36 precompiles that the finding cites.
verdicts.codeCheck: sync reads currency.balanceOfSelf() and stores it with the currency (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288). balanceOfSelf is a high level balanceOf call (src/types/Currency.sol:90-96). _settle credits reservesNow minus reservesBefore as the synced currency and rejects msg.value when a token is synced (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364). take debits the caller by amount.toInt128() and then transfers (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297). For a token, transfer calls the currency with the transfer selector and accepts empty return data or a 32 byte word equal to 1 (src/types/Currency.sol:53-80). For the native currency it sends value with empty calldata (src/types/Currency.sol:44-52). Hook calls go only to key.hooks with IHooks calldata and require a 32 byte response with the matching selector (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:131-153). A credit booked in the precompile's own currency is only spendable as that currency, so other users' balances in other currencies are not reachable without a pool whose LPs chose to hold that currency. A native value call into the predeploy is paid from the caller's own delta. The finding's reading holds, and no path to other users' funds exists while the upgrade is not shipped.
